---
title: "{{< fa book >}} Background reading"
---

Four short pages covering the themes the workshop works through. They are [optional]{.highlight-yellow}: the day is built so you can follow it without having read them, and everything here comes up again in the introduction.

Read them if you would rather arrive with the arguments already in mind, or come back to them afterwards when you are deciding what to change about how you work.

Everything cited across these four pages is collected on the [references page](../references.qmd), with a link to each source.

| Page | The question it answers |
|------|------|
| [Security](security.qmd) | What must never go into the tool? |
| [Literacy](literacy.qmd) | What do you need to know before you can use the output? |
| [Transparency](transparency.qmd) | What does the workflow record for you? |
| [Disclosure](disclosure.qmd) | What do you say about it, and to whom? |

: {tbl-colwidths="[25,75]"}

The order runs from rules, to judgement, to mechanism, to reporting. The workshop demonstrates all four in the hands-on part.

::: {.callout-note}
## The one page to read if you read only one

[Security](security.qmd). The others shape how you think; that one has rules you need before the first session, not after.
:::
